summary: A member separates the work of stamping containers from the work of taking them back.
realLife: Campbell described distinct proposed payments for the grocer handling returns and the distributor marking packages. Resident Earl Lubensky favored compensating only the retailer.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: proposed allowances and enacted version.

turns.what: The sponsor asks each business to identify the job its payment covers.
turns.pulledBy: Members retain both allowances in an amendment.
turns.writesBack: The estimate shows a separate cost for each task.

turns.what: A distributor brings the labeling invoice back to committee.
turns.writesBack: Distributors ask the sponsor who absorbs the marking expense.
